Description: Log in via the shared login flow. Recorded identity-provider steps are intentionally not imported - login is shared, not per-feature
Navigate to app page
Wait for the landing page to finish loading. Polls instead of sleeping; the app cold-starts slowly and never goes network-idle
click New Project
fill projectName (made unique per run with runId)
Select Time Unit. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
Pick the Start Date in the calendar (shared selectStartDate). REVIEW the Start Date value in testdata - dates cannot be inferred reliably from a recording
Select Study Objective. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
Select Phase. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
fill populationName 0
fill treatmentArm 0
fill endpointName 0
Select Endpoint Type. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
Select Better Response. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
click Create Project
click Inputs
click New Input Set
fill collectionName
click Design Compute or simulate a
Select Select Test. select opens the menu and commits the option itself - works for native and custom dropdowns
click Continue
Select Hypothesis. Native <select> - select matches by visible label first
select Computed Parameter
fill Sample Size (n)
fill Power (input when Sample Size is computed; skipped as N/A/Computed otherwise)
Select Test Type (native <select>)
fill Type 1 Error (recording mislabeled this #type1Error field as Test Type)
Select Input Method. Native <select> - select matches by visible label first
fill Noninferiority Margin
fill Ratio of Means (Non-Inferiority; N/A on Superiority)
fill Ratio of Means (Superiority; N/A on Non-Inferiority)
fill Mean Control (Individual Means; N/A otherwise)
fill Mean Treatment (Individual Means; N/A otherwise)
Select Test Statistic. Native <select> - select matches by visible label first
fill Standard Deviation of Log Ratio
click Save
click Save Compute
fill Result Name
click credit alert primary
Poll the run status until Completed before opening the result
Open the computed result by name (only appears once compute finishes)
Capture EVERY table on the result page. Requires custom/<Feature>/customSteps.ts to export extractAllResultTables
Compare captured cells against 06_baseline/<env>/. First run writes the baseline and reports BASELINE_CREATED (green but verifies nothing); every later run is a real PASS/FAIL
